narrative.intro: Savannah River Mission Completion obligated $1.1B in federal contracts year to date. Savannah River Mission Completion received 7 awards so far, with an average award size of $153M and obligations up 0.9% year over year. The current-year totals are partial because the period is FY2026 to date. Fiscal-year history shows obligations moved from $0 in FY21 to $642M in FY22, then to $823M in FY23, $886M in FY24, $1.1B in FY25, and $1.1B in FY26. This profile reflects a rapid build from FY22 and stabilization at $1.1B in the most recent two reported fiscal years. Contract totals here are obligations except where tables list award-value figures as total contract values. The figures are useful for sizing Savannah River Mission Completion as a federal vendor and for comparing award count and average award size to peers.
